description: This file defines the AzureOpenAIConfig class, which provides configuration and utility methods for integrating Azure's OpenAI chat API, including parameter handling, environment validation, and response transformation logic.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure's OpenAI chat API, including parameter management, environment validation, and response handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object with optional parameters, setting class attributes accordingly.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration dictionary from the superclass.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for the model.

methods.name: _is_response_format_supported_model
methods.description: Checks if the given model supports response_format based on model name patterns.

methods.name: _is_response_format_supported_api_version
methods.description: Checks if the API version supports response_format based on year and month.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters, handling version-specific constraints.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms messages and parameters into the request payload for Azure OpenAI API.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Placeholder for response transformation logic, raises NotImplementedError.

methods.name: map_special_auth_params
methods.description: Maps 'token' parameter to 'azure_ad_token' in optional parameters.

methods.name: get_eu_regions
methods.description: Returns list of European regions supported by Azure OpenAI.

methods.name: get_us_regions
methods.description: Returns list of US regions supported by Azure OpenAI.

methods.name: get_error_class
